description: Schema for vault graph.json emitted by build_graph.py and consumed by the TypeScript visualizer (visualizer/lib/graph.ts GraphData).

w.description: Edge weight. Semantic edges: cosine similarity in [-1, 1] (writer emits >= min_semantic_threshold). Wiki edges: 1.0.

generated.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp the graph was built.

include_daily.description: Whether Daily-folder notes are included in the node set. Participates in the incremental compatibility check because it changes which nodes exist.

incremental.description: True when this graph was produced by an incremental rebuild (ENH-002). Absent on full-rebuild graphs.

max_neighbors.description: Maximum semantic edges kept per note, strongest first (ENH-001). 0 disables the cap and emits every pair above min_semantic_threshold.

parsight_body_links.description: Wiki edges contributed by parsight body-link enrichment. Absent when enrichment was skipped or added nothing.

parsight_body_status.description: Outcome of parsight body-link enrichment when it was attempted (present whenever --no-parsight was not passed). 'fresh' = index current, enrichment ran (count in parsight_body_links when >=1); 'skipped:index-stale' / 'skipped:index-absent' / 'skipped:index-invalid' = a non-fresh index made enrichment non-deterministic so it was skipped; 'unavailable' / 'error' = backend failure.

schema_version.description: On-disk graph.json shape version (GRAPH_SCHEMA_VERSION in build_graph.py). The incremental loader compares this against its own constant and full-rebuilds on mismatch.

id.description: Note stem — the unique node identity.

mtime.description: Note modification time as a unix timestamp.

path.description: Vault-relative path to the note file.

title: GraphData
